method: Triangle path, owner-mask fix on. Quality: native structure-motion suite, 20 triangle cases (10 camera paths x 64/128 textures), limits rms 0.05, frame 0.08, local 0.12, MAE 0.08. Cost: 6 views (fortress/arena/watchtower x exterior/gate), 360x240, budget 2048, 6 warm-up + 60 measured frames per setting per view, settings interleaved round-robin, 2 repetitions; per-view ratio of p50 total submission ms against today's setting in the same view and run; median of the 12 ratios. performance.now() resolution 0.1 ms (about 4% of the 2.7 ms baseline).

planar.note: Separate interleaved run on the same 6 views x 60 frames x 2 runs, ratio to today's triangle setting in the same view and run. The same run re-measured errorPixels 0.3 at +16.2% (depth 7) and +16.3% (depth 10).

tails: Tight-loop p95/max are dominated by 40-95 ms stalls in both modes (planar 6-10 of 90 frames over 16.67 ms solo, triangles 3-4), consistent with GPU command backpressure when frames are not rAF-paced. Tails are not plotted; see the rAF-paced A/B/B/A tables in TEXTURES.md.
g2_method: Native Chromium (in-app), same page as the first sweep, owner-mask fix on. Motion: native structure-motion suite, triangle cases only, tessellate replaced by longface/snippets g2_tiebreak_2pct.js (TIE 0.02) or g0_control_tie0.js (TIE 0) with errorPixels/maxDepth overridden. Control: g0 reproduces production on all 20 cases to 4 decimals; production reproduces the first sweep exactly. Cost: 7 settings interleaved round-robin, 6 views x (6 warm + 60 measured) x 2 runs (view order reversed), ratio of p50 to production e0.65 d7 in the same view and run, median of 12.

hybrid_run.method: Third run, same six views x (6 warm + 60 frames) x 2 runs, settings interleaved; hybrid = drawPlanarFace declines column (wall) faces, which fall back to tie-broken triangles. Motion: native suite via the planar cases with the decline wrapper, then confirmed on the real structures.html page after implementing rowsOnly: hybrid 20/20, planar 20/20, triangles 17/20, all controls pass.
